findings.message: RUN-001 FINDING 1 (MCQ 4 key conflicts with stem) - RESOLVED, verified independently. unit-assessment.mdx:77-82 now reads 'A workshop lasts a single day. Which principle does that one fact directly violate?' with options a) chosen rather than assigned b) sustained over time c) collaborative d) supported by feedback. I solved it before reading the key and derived 'b', from topic-01.mdx:116-117 ('Sustained over time ... This rules out the one-day event as a complete intervention'). unit-assessment.mdx:189-190 keys 'b' and explicitly disclaims the other three ('Whether a workshop is also unchosen, solitary or unsupported by feedback depends on facts the stem does not give'). The 'all of the above' option and the superlative stem are both gone; the stem now supplies exactly one attribute and exactly one principle answers to it.

RUN-001 FINDING 2 (RRQ 7 mark scheme contradicts topic-03) - RESOLVED. unit-assessment.mdx:222-227 no longer awards action 1 a principle ('focus') that topic-03 never lists. It now reads 'Decide before leaving which single thing you will try (1, and with the fortnight comparison below it supplies sustained); ... (2, supplies collaborative); ... summary: G3 run 002 of EFMP-302 Unit 6, reviewed against the frozen bundle at commit 4ae0952. All 137 bound inputs were recomputed with the contract's own inputManifest() and matched the prepared manifest exactly, with no missing paths and no digest drift. DISPOSITION: escalate. Five of the six blocking findings from run 001 are genuinely repaired and I verified each independently rather than on the commit's say-so: MCQ 4 is rewritten and correctly keyed (I derived all ten MCQ answers before reading the key and agreed 10/10); RRQ 7's mark scheme no longer contradicts topic-03; all eight figures now render as <Figure> elements with working dark variants, so the six 'the figure above' references resolve; the approved blueprint is now met on both counts, ERQ 4 having been retargeted to Topic 6.4 as a plan critique; and the run-001 claim that the ERQ rubrics were unreachable at 360px is refuted by re-measurement - each table is its own scroll container, is focusable with role=region and an accessible name, responds to ArrowRight, and reveals 'Strong (4-5)' in full when scrolled. Escalation rests on three things. First, source support is unverifiable for the entire unit: none of Unit 6's six keys has a bound excerpt and all six are declared unretrievable, so every source-dependent claim stands on citation existence alone. Second, four run-001 findings needing owner decisions remain open (day1999 over-attribution, the content-spec worked-example divergence, the missing no-external-source rows, and two unsourced empirical claims one of which now carries an MCQ key). Third, the newly rendered figures introduced blocking defects of their own: text clipped past the viewBox in fig-U6-2 and fig-U6-5, connector arrows overdrawing three labels in fig-U6-2, and an unreserved image box that reflows the page by 170px per figure on load. This is the second review cycle for this submission, which exhausts the skill's two-cycle limit, and the sources question cannot be settled by a further author repair. This report is advisory only: no qualification, registry activation, signature or tracker transition is claimed or implied.
